ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.
   D. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.
   B. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.
   C. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings able to:? (1 mark)

   B. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Enlightened Beings able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Enlightened Beings able to: has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Names of Scriptures able to: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures able to:.
   C. Use Names of Scriptures able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in? (1 mark)

   A. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
